title: Jurisdiction Rule Registry Entry
description: Schema for registering a single jurisdiction's copyright rules with official source verification.

official_source_url.description: URL to official legislative database or authoritative source

key_articles_sections.description: Key articles or sections governing exceptions

contract_override_notable.description: Notable provisions where contracts cannot override statutory exceptions

legal_regime_scope.description: The applicable copyright legal regime modeled by this entry (e.g. the statute and its enforceable scope). Technical rule-modeling field, NOT a sovereignty claim.

territorial_law_scope.description: Territory within which the modeled legal regime applies/enforces.

sovereignty_position.description: This registry models applicable legal regimes only. It asserts no position on sovereignty or political status. The only permitted value is NOT_ASSERTED.

sovereignty_note.description: Optional clarification that this entry models a legal regime in scope and asserts no sovereignty or political position.

verification_status.description: Verification status of the official-source rule. OFFICIAL_TEXT_NOT_VERIFIED / LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED must be used when full text or a stable version cannot be obtained.

provenance.description: Auditable official-source provenance for the rule (P5).

contract_override_provenance.description: Provenance for a downgraded (bounded) contract-override claim, e.g. the US fair-use claim no longer asserted as absolute/non-waivable.
